# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 82 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 82 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_082_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Chapter 5

**1** "Are there then no others who will enter the tower?" I asked. He answered, "There are those who have entered the tower and those who have not yet but shall enter. **2** But all those who do not repent shall not enter the tower." **3** "Then tell me," I said, "what those who have repented must do to enter the tower." **4** He said, "Their rods shall be cut and planted by him who gave them; and if any of them take root and none of them wither, they shall live. But if any wither, they shall die." **5** I said, "Lord, and if they have repented but have not purified themselves and do not live righteously after repenting — will they still enter the tower?" He said, "Repentance that does not bear fruit will not bring them into the tower. For they must bring forth fruit worthy of repentance." **6** "But are the rods not to be withheld from those who returned them? Did they not receive the seal?" **7** "No," he said, "the seal belongs to the water. They go down into the water dead and come up alive. Therefore the seal was also proclaimed to these, and they make use of it to enter the kingdom of God." **8** "Why then, Lord," I asked, "did the forty stones come up first from the deep and fit together in the tower, occupying the corners and sides?" **9** He said to me, "Because these were the first to believe and were foremost among the righteous — the apostles and teachers who preached the name of the Son of God and fell asleep in the power and faith of the Son of God." **10** "Why then," I said, "did the virgins also take part in the building of the tower, carrying the stones?" **11** "Because they are holy spirits, and they are the powers of the Son of God. Without them no one can enter the kingdom of God; for if one takes the name upon himself but does not receive the clothing of these virgins, he shall benefit nothing at all — for these virgins are the powers of the Son of God."

---

### Translator's Note
This chapter bridges Similitude 8 and the coming Similitude 9. The forty apostolic/foundational stones, the virgins as virtues, and the seal of baptism all reappear in the great Tower Vision. Verse 7 contains one of the clearest baptismal theology statements in the Shepherd: descent into water as death, emergence as new life. SOPHIA follows LOGOS throughout.
